router_contract.method: frozen-parent single-token A-M statistical family classifier

menu.description: difference in continuous means for independent groups or paired before-after values; not causal identification
categorical proportions, contingency tables, binary risk difference, or sparse cells
continuous regression slope with heteroskedasticity, outliers, or leverage
binary or count regression, logistic/Poisson/negative-binomial model, or separation
clustered, nested, or repeated observations with ICC, group IDs, or within-unit dependence
time-to-event, censoring, hazards, or survival curves
missing outcomes, response mechanisms, selection bias, imputation, or weighting for missingness
causal ATE or policy effect under randomization or observational confounding; not a plain mean difference
one-sample probability distribution, population location, skew/tails, or distributional fit; not groups
priors, posterior estimation, or posterior predictive checks
out-of-sample predictions, held-out discrimination, or probability calibration; not coefficient estimation
chronological time series, forecast horizon, rolling validation, drift, or future-data leakage
truly insufficient outcome, estimand, sampling-unit, and design information to choose a family

claim_boundary: The frozen v0.3 parent predicts one A-M route token, and low confidence or M falls back to the parent. This adds one short model pass and remains synthetic-first evidence.
